e22_esb_population: Four rows of the E22-DEV-ESB-1500-V1 roster, chosen before any contact by the SAME deterministic rule the 2026-09-05 dev smoke and the 2026-09-04 test smoke used -- longest, shortest, median and p90 by duration over the drawn 1,500, ties broken by sample id: 4482383-188 the LONGEST at 32.880000 s (the window-fit and VRAM worst case of this subset), 4469088-654 the SHORTEST at 0.219938 s, 4482613-439 the median at 5.580313 s and 4479944-334 the p90 at 13.020250 s. The smoke's own WER numbers are on four rows and enter no verdict.
e22_esb_identity_hash_convention: e22_esb_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('earnings22-original', sample_ids)) over earnings22-original/<call>-<segment>, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time and the value an exposure row must carry.
e22_esb_d1_media_supplement: The same additive media supplement the full 1,500-row fragment names; these four ids are four of its 1,500.
e22_esb_split_role_basis: No owner allowance is involved and none is claimed: these four utterances come from four calls of this study's registered earnings22-original dev subset10 (docs/receipts/splits.json, split 'dev'). No confirmatory call is named, loaded, decoded, scored or read.
e22_esb_reference_boundary: The 'sentence' column is gold and NEVER enters the request path. The roster receipt this fragment names carries identifiers, media paths, measured media identity and segment spans only.
e22_esb_exposure: Pre-flight 4-row dry run required by section 6.6 of docs/readiness/2026-09-06-e22-dev-usage-cells-v1-preregistration.md. Each cell's smoke is its own run id with its own exposure row, because the two cells' geometries, decoders and budgets differ. This fragment grants no contact authority; the preregistration and the exposure ledger do.
e22_esb_smoke_stopcap_tokens: Under cell (b)'s alpha-1.5 duration-proportional rule these four rows resolve to caps of 3, 127, 321 and 55 tokens respectively -- the smoke therefore exercises the floor-adjacent, the median, the ceiling-adjacent and a mid-range cap in one pass, which is what makes four rows a real test of the per-sample seam rather than of one arbitrary cap.
